name: fight15-s27
title: The Timing page: no do-nothing control, a cost hint for every row

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonLobbyOptions
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageTiming
wait_ms 600
video_mark timing-host
assert_no_caption CollectionBoxHostPageTiming Recalculate
assert_visible LabelHostNetPing 1
assert_text_fits LabelHostNetPing
assert_label_absent LabelHostNetSlowPolicyHint later version
focus ComboHostNetPolicy
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelHostNetOptionHint Automatic sizes each player's delay from their ping; Fixed uses the numbers you type
assert_text_fits LabelHostNetOptionHint
focus TextHostNetMinDelay
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelHostNetOptionHint No player's delay drops below this; a higher floor rides out spikes but every press lands later
assert_text_fits LabelHostNetOptionHint
focus TextHostNetSlowBound
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelHostNetOptionHint How late a player may fall before the AI holds their seat; lower keeps everyone else smooth
assert_text_fits LabelHostNetOptionHint
focus ComboHostNetRedundancy
wait_ms 300
assert_label LabelHostNetOptionHint Each packet repeats this many earlier ticks; more rides out lost packets but uses more bandwidth
assert_text_fits LabelHostNetOptionHint
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/scene-end.json 120
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/scene-end.json 300
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit

checklist.what: The Timing page holds no do-nothing control; each row's hint names what its choice costs.
